Title: UmbraDesktop Multimedia
Description: Sound and pictures for UmbraDesktop. An optional add-on that puts Media Player, Picture Viewer and Sound Recorder on the desktop, each in a window of its own and working with the files in your media library.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features.

RelatedPackages.Description: The desktop itself. This package is an add-on to it and installs it as a dependency; the desktop works on its own without the multimedia programs.
Notepad, Paint, Sticky Notes, Calculator, Disk Cleanup and the rest of Windows' Accessories for the desktop. Independent of this package: install either, both or neither.
Games for the desktop: Minesweeper, Snake and Solitaire. Independent of this package: install either, both or neither.

Screenshots.Caption: Media Player, Picture Viewer and Sound Recorder on the desktop under the Windows 98 theme, each in a window of its own with its own taskbar button.
